tools.name: get_score_card
tools.description: Health score (0-100), five pillar scores, valuation verdict (Undervalued / Fair Value / Overvalued / Inconclusive) with confidence, estimated fair value when published, key findings, next earnings date and the card URL for one US-listed ticker.

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: The valuation verdict and why: zone, confidence, the basis of the verdict, the engine's estimate (point or range) and the methods that drove it, plus a one-sentence explanation when no single fair value is published.

tools.name: rank_sector
tools.description: Top companies in a sector by TradeApes health score with valuation verdicts, and this week's biggest score changes. Use list_sectors for valid sector names.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: The sector names TradeApes uses, with the number of scored companies in each.

tools.name: search_tickers
tools.description: Find US-listed tickers matching a company name or symbol fragment.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: The full TradeApes analysis article for a ticker when one is public: markdown text, article date, whether a newer filing has superseded it, and the article URL. Does not generate one.
